If you want to build the app yourself, follow these steps:

• Clone the repo:.

versions.localizedDescription:
Finally AnimeGen v3.0.0. is here!:

Took me a bit but i finally recoded the app completely. No new sources but they were all improved a lot. Some sources got removed since they were not working at lot for a lot of time.

The UI now is more simple and made to work all on the bottom of the screen. The app size is now 3 times smaller. The only real issue anyone could find is that it cant save .gif images yet.

You can either sideload the ipa or install AnimeGen via TestFlight.

The NSFW option has been removed and it will never return back.
